create_Line_patch: create a Line PathPatch with radian and radius limits for linear radial lines
create_ArcLine_patch: create an ArcLine PathPatch with curved radian and radius limits for arc-shaped lines
create_ArcRectangle_patch: create an ArcRectangle PathPatch from anchor point with radian width and radius height
create_ArcArrow_patch: create an ArcArrow PathPatch with radian and radius dimensions and arrow head
create_BezierCurveLink_patch: create a BezierCurveLink PathPatch connecting two radial regions with directional arrows
